label: 4 November 2026
title: Flick names XI for Aston Villa; Camp Nou holds minute of silence
deck: Hansi Flick starts Brian Fariñas and Gerard Martín against Unai Emery’s side. UEFA drops the Champions League anthem for Jesús de Miguel and the Urda victims. Prince William and Prince George attend.

stories.headline: Flick starts Fariñas and Gerard Martín against Villa
stories.summary: Hansi Flick named Brian Fariñas at right-back and Gerard Martín in central defence for the Champions League meeting with Aston Villa at Spotify Camp Nou. Anthony Gordon returned on the left. Alejandro Balde stayed on the bench.
stories.body: The German made two changes from the 6-1 win over Alavés. Gerard Martín replaced Frenkie de Jong in the centre of defence and Gordon came in for Karim Adeyemi. Joan García started in goal, with Fariñas, Pau Cubarsí, Martín and João Cancelo across the back. Rodri and Pedri formed the midfield pivot, with Lamine Yamal, Fermín López and Gordon supporting Raphinha. The six injured players — Eric García, Jules Koundé, Xavi Espart, Andreas Christensen, Dani Olmo and Roony Bardghji — remained unavailable. De Jong, Gavi, Bernal, Adeyemi, Gabriel Jesus and Balde were among the substitutes. Kick-off was at 21:00 CET.

stories.headline: Minute of silence at Camp Nou; Champions League anthem dropped
stories.summary: Spotify Camp Nou held a minute of silence for CD Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel and the victims of the Urda train crash. UEFA decided the Champions League anthem would not be played.
stories.body: De Miguel, 30, died after a collision in Tenerife’s match against Andorra on Monday. The Urda accident the previous week left 69 dead. UEFA instructed clubs in its competitions to observe a minute of silence this week and, for the Barcelona-Aston Villa match, to forgo the usual pre-match anthem. The decision was announced over the stadium public address. Joan Laporta had earlier expressed the club’s condolences. The match itself began at 21:00 under the altered protocol.

tweets.name: Mundo Deportivo
tweets.text: 🔇 El himno de la Champions no suena en España. ⚫ La UEFA hizo cambios en su protocolo en solidaridad a las víctimas del accidente de trenes y tras la muerte de Jesús de Miguel

stories.headline: Prince William and Prince George at Spotify Camp Nou
stories.summary: The Prince of Wales and his eldest son attended Barcelona’s Champions League match against Aston Villa. Both are long-standing Villa supporters. Joan Laporta hosted them in the presidential box.
stories.body: Barcelona confirmed the royal visit ahead of kick-off. Prince William has attended several of Villa’s European matches in recent years, including the 2025 Champions League quarter-final in Paris with George and the 2026 Europa League final in Istanbul. The club said it was honoured to welcome them for an evening featuring their beloved side. Also in the box were UEFA observer Rafa Benítez, former Barça player and 1977 Ballon d’Or winner Allan Simonsen, and Aston Villa CEO Damià Vidagany. Laporta was due to present personalised shirts.

tweets.name: FC Barcelona
tweets.text: FC Barcelona is honoured to welcome His Royal Highness The Prince of Wales and His Royal Highness Prince George to the Spotify Camp Nou. Thank you for joining us for a special evening of Champions League football featuring your beloved Aston Villa.

stories.headline: Juvenil A draw 3-3 with Aston Villa in Youth League
stories.summary: Barcelona’s under-19s drew 3-3 with Aston Villa at the Johan Cruyff after leading 2-0. Ebrima Tunkara and Joni Hernández scored early; Iu Martínez equalised in the 90th minute.
stories.body: Pol Planas’s side took control in the first half. Tunkara opened the scoring in the ninth minute and Hernández added a second on 23 minutes after a counter. Villa responded through Carroll (38’ and 45’) to go in level at the break, then Meade put them 2-3 ahead in the 81st. Iu Martínez scored the equaliser deep in stoppage time. The result left Barça with one win, one defeat and two draws in the competition. Hamza Abdelkarim started before being substituted at half-time. Joni Hernández dedicated his goal to Jesús de Miguel.

stories.headline: Six senior players still unavailable for Villa
stories.summary: Eric García, Jules Koundé, Xavi Espart, Andreas Christensen, Dani Olmo and Roony Bardghji missed the match. Flick expects most to return after the international break.
stories.body: The defensive absences forced the use of Fariñas at right-back and the continuation of a reshaped back line. Espart’s syndesmosis injury carries the longest recovery; Flick has indicated he may not see him until early next year. Christensen had completed part of a session as a neutral player earlier in the week but remained in the gym. De Jong and Fariñas have covered centre-back and full-back roles in recent matches. Aston Villa were without Amadou Onana, Matteo Ruggeri and Aaron Wan-Bissaka. Barça next travel to the Metropolitano on 8 November to face Atlético Madrid.

stories.headline: 23-man squad named; five B-team players included
stories.summary: Hansi Flick called up 23 players for Aston Villa. Hamza Abdelkarim, Orian Goren, Guillem Víctor, Àlex Campos and Iker Rodríguez were among those named.
stories.body: The full list comprised Joan García, Cancelo, Balde, Fariñas, Cubarsí, Gavi, Fermín, Pedri, Gabriel Jesus, Lamine Yamal, Raphinha, Szczesny, Adeyemi, Rodri, Gordon, Gerard Martín, De Jong, Bernal, Livakovic, Abdelkarim, Orian, Guillem V. and Campos. The five from Barça Atlètic had trained with the first team in the build-up. Balde remained available from the bench after limited recent minutes. The club confirmed the six long-term absentees before kick-off. Preparations had concluded with a full session on Monday.

stories.headline: Barça aim to respond after PSG defeat
stories.summary: Barcelona sit eighth in the Champions League league phase on six points after three matches. Aston Villa arrived with nine points from three wins. Hansi Flick has targeted a top-eight finish.
stories.body: The side beat Feyenoord 5-1 and Galatasaray 4-1 before losing 4-2 in Paris. In La Liga they responded to the Clásico defeat with a 6-1 win over Alavés, with Yamal and Raphinha each scoring twice. Flick described Unai Emery as one of the best coaches in Europe and said Villa possess clear structure and different attacking patterns. He noted Nicolas Jackson is in excellent form. The German said nothing had changed about the objective of finishing in the top eight despite the two recent setbacks. The match marked the return of European football to Camp Nou after 55 days.

stories.headline: Atlético Madrid next after Villa
stories.summary: Barcelona face Atlético Madrid at the Metropolitano on Sunday 8 November at 21:00. The international break follows, with Villarreal, Sabah and Deportivo still to come in the month.
stories.body: The Champions League fixture was the first of five matches in November. Atlético host on Sunday. Players will then depart for national-team duty from 9 to 17 November. Barça return to host Villarreal on 22 November at 14:00, travel to Sabah on 25 November at 18:45 in the Champions League, and finish the month away to Deportivo on 28 or 29 November. Several of the currently injured players are aimed at availability after the break.

stories.headline: Cubarsí, Pedri, Rodri and Yamal remain in FIFPRO World XI shortlist
stories.summary: The four Barça players are among the 26 candidates for the men’s FIFPRO World XI. The final team is due to be announced on 9 November.
stories.body: Almost 20,000 professional players from 75 countries voted for the shortlist. Cubarsí appears among the defenders, Pedri and Rodri in midfield, and Yamal among the attackers alongside Harry Kane, Lionel Messi, Kylian Mbappé and Cristiano Ronaldo. Raphinha was not included. The club also noted that several women’s players from the side feature on the corresponding shortlist, including Cata Coll. The men’s World XI will be revealed on 9 November.
